verdict.rationale: Zulip documents its own framework for interactive bots that react to messages, run as custom or existing bots and deployable via the Zulip Botserver. That gives first-party support for a bot taking part in conversations, but the AI behavior would have to be built by the user, and nothing in the evidence shows mention-triggered replies or adding a bot to a channel. missing for 10: evidence of mention-triggered bot responses, documentation of adding a bot as a channel member, any first-party or ready-made AI agent integration, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned

citations.quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
deploying it on a server using the Zulip Botserver
